name: Pod break probe (in-game test)
description: In-game test only, never shipped: an EAT-17 copy (register_entity, as the Stratagem Compendium's Expendables are) on a copy of the EAT-17's hellpod rack, and the vanilla rack, each under a stratagem of its own put in the loadout on the ship; called in, each rack is broken by the game's own rack death, and the dropped launchers' pickups are logged, one PROBE line per check, for the development harness (tests/in-game/README.md).
